title: "Aggregate ERA5 Using The Fishnet"
subtitle: "Validate the final aggregation workspace"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
---

This page stands in for the final aggregation step, where prepared geometry and
downloaded ERA5 files are brought together into analysis-ready summaries.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Fishnet Preparation"}

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

assert Path("data/interim/fishnet").is_dir(), "Expected fishnet directory from the previous page."
assert Path("data/interim/fishnet/README.txt").exists(), "Expected fishnet manifest from the previous page."
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create The Processed Output Directory"}

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

processed_dir = Path("data/processed")
processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Record The Intended Aggregation Output"}

```{python}
#| eval: false
from pathlib import Path

summary_path = Path("data/processed/era5_daily_summary.csv")
summary_path.write_text("date,metric,value\n", encoding="utf-8")
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify Aggregation Workspace"}

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

summary_path = Path("data/processed/era5_daily_summary.csv")
assert summary_path.exists(), "Expected processed ERA5 summary file to exist."
assert summary_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").startswith("date,metric,value")
```

:::
